title: RunResult
description: The output of running a Mission scenario through sim-services' discrete-event runner (ARCHITECTURE.md Section 11/13). This is the 'run-result' data contract Section 13 deferred until sim-services was scoped: the planned-timeline shape (Mission.timeline) plus execution fields (status, simulated timestamp, artifact reference) so model-explorer's v2 results view can render it without being rebuilt.

missionId.description: id of the org-doctrine-model Mission record this run executed.

doctrineProcessId.description: id of the DoctrineProcess the Mission references, for cross-referencing step artifacts.

startedAt.description: Wall-clock time the run started (real time, not simulated).

completedAt.description: Wall-clock time the run finished (real time, not simulated).

federationPublished.description: Whether this run's per-step state was published to the org-doctrine-model HLA federation via federation-kernel. False when federation-kernel's jar wasn't available - see sim-services README.

doctrineProcessStep.description: stepNumber in the referenced DoctrineProcess this corresponds to, if any - matches Mission.timeline[].doctrineProcessStep.

status.description: Mission 1 v1's runner is a linear discrete-event sequence with no retry/failure branching yet - every step that ran reaches Complete. Failure at the run level is reported via the top-level 'status' field, not per-step.

simulatedTimestamp.description: Logical/simulated time this step occurred, decoupled from wall-clock run time - see sim-services README for why.

artifactProduced.description: The DoctrineProcess step's producesArtifact, when doctrineProcessStep resolves to one - null otherwise.
